Original tuition fee: 44,000 RMB / year

Scholarship Policy:

Full Scholarship: Free tuition fee, on-campus accommodation fee and comprehensive medical insurance. Stipend: 3500 RMB/month.

programs.feeNotes: 1-Registration fee: 400 RMB (non-refundable) needs to be paid when submitting the application. 2-Accommodation fee： Jiangning Campus: 12,000 RMB/ year (Single room) Changzhou Campus: 7,200 RMB / year (Double Room) 3-Insurance premium: 800 RMB / year
